title: Concept: Archive extraction via entry.extract (ruby) — review required
description: In ruby, entry.extract writes archive members to the filesystem. Entry names are attacker-controlled metadata in hostile archives, so extraction without name checks is a write primitive. The remedy is per-entry validation via entry-name validation before write.
applicability: ruby codebases extracting archives through entry.extract; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Arbitrary file overwrite (Zip Slip) from hostile archives; HIGH severity because archives routinely cross trust boundaries.
